items.title: Is the hotel adults-only?
items.description: To maintain a serene atmosphere, Pelagia Suites welcomes guests aged 16 and older.

items.title: How do I arrange an airport transfer?
items.description: Simply provide your flight details 48 hours in advance, and our private chauffeur will meet you at JTR Airport.

items.title: Are the pools heated?
items.description: Yes, all private suite pools are maintained at a comfortable 28°C year-round.

items.title: What is the cancellation policy?
items.description: We offer flexible cancellation up to 21 days before arrival for most seasonal bookings.
